$comment: Career playmats (CAREER_PLAYMATS): the print each one lays over its cloth's dye in the match and in the locker.
style: Playmat prints: one large circular ornamental design per cell, front view, perfectly symmetrical, printed ONLY in ivory line work (no second ink, no filled background inside the circle), like a design screen-printed onto a cloth mat. Each design fills about 95% of its cell.

items.subject: a desert compass rose inside a sun ring with dune-wave engravings
a ring of interlaced stone-carved knotwork around a mountain range
a celestial ring of constellations around a crescent moon and stars
a ring of climbing roses and thorny vines around a single blooming rose
